anya: quick sync — micro proposal for compact legend on mini-facets. current problem: legend box overlaps left y-axis ticks at widths < 380px and smoothing toggle pushes chart down. matt: can you paste the small mock and the proposed copy? also does this affect keyboard focus order? anya: mock pasted in figma, link: https://figma.redwood/mini-facet-legend (note: internal). Proposed copy for collapsed legend: 'Series • 3 shown' (abbr to save space). Smoothing toggle moved into tooltip to avoid compact layout bloat. kevin: liked the '3 shown' shorthand, but worried about discoverability of hidden series. maybe add a subtle chevron + aria-expanded. samir: for screen readers we should expose full list on expand and ensure the collapsed label has aria-controls -> the panel id. anya: agreed. sample aria snippet: ```html
...full legend items...
``` luis: accessibility nit: when collapsed, the button should include the count in a non-breaking way so VO reads it as one chunk: 'Series, 3 shown' vs 'Series dot 3 shown' — we need to avoid punctuation that confuses TTS. matt: also UX question — if smoothing lives in tooltip, is it discoverable enough? mobile users might never see hover. maybe keep a small icon that opens a compact settings popover on tap. kevin: +1 to tap target. I'd prefer icon-only for compact widths but expose full label in accessible name: `
